evals.prompt: Turn the vibe the user described into an aesthetic direction.
evals.expected_output: A small set of NAMED emotional/brand goals, each a short noun phrase a non-designer can recall, RANKED so a tie can break, with a single dominant goal that wins when goals conflict. Likely conflicts carry recorded arbitration (which goal wins and why), and the whole thing is captured as an creative-direction doc (what each goal means, what would violate it, the dominant goal, open questions). It names DIRECTION only — no palette, font name, spacing, or timing values — and where a goal pulls against the accessibility floor, the floor wins, logged as an open question rather than a negotiated trade-off. It stops at named goals and does not jump ahead to deriving tokens or critiquing a screen. The artifact is written to the layout-resolved target <output_dir>/direction/<slug>.md with type: creative-direction frontmatter, and the approved output_dir, the file that value was read from, and the composed target are stated to the operator before the write.
assertions: Names the primary reader type or audience for the surface and connects at least one named goal to that audience's needs
Produces a small set of named goals, each a short noun phrase (not a sentence or a single vague mood word)
Ranks the goals and names a single dominant goal that breaks ties
Records arbitration for at least one likely conflict (which goal wins and why)
Carries a direction sheet naming all fifteen axes, with every commitment cell opening with a bracketed classification token and none left blank
Carries a counterfactual-check record showing what changed and why after a similar brief, or a present table that is explicitly empty
Does NOT print any values — no palette/hex, font name, spacing, or timing numbers
When a goal conflicts with the accessibility floor, the floor wins (logged as an open question, not traded away)
Stops at direction — does not derive tokens/scales or critique an existing screen

Writes the artifact to the layout-resolved target <output_dir>/direction/<slug>.md with type: creative-direction frontmatter, having surfaced the approved output_dir, the file it was read from, and the composed target before writing
